title.en: den gamle by in the christmas season.
title.de: den gamle by in der weihnachtszeit.

line.en: the open-air old town opens its christmas season on 14 november. walk the lanes before the light goes, around 16:00.
line.de: das freilichtmuseum startet am 14. november in die weihnachtszeit. spaziergang durch die gassen, bevor es gegen 16 uhr dunkel wird.
line.tr: açık hava eski kent 14 kasımda noel sezonunu açıyor. ışık gitmeden, 16 civarında sokaklarda yürü.

sparks.why: Christmas in Den Gamle By runs 14 Nov to 31 Dec 2026 (visitdenmark.com events calendar); daily hours of 10:00 to 17:00 come from a third-party listing (excursionmania), so check the museum site.
